# Finance rules

Only you can see this file. The rest of the team needs these facts.

Launch costs (each is spent in the week the product launches): Atlas $70,000; Beacon $80,000; Ember $35,000; Garnet $50,000; Harbor $35,000; Indigo $90,000.

- Atlas must launch in an earlier week than Beacon.
- Indigo must launch in an earlier week than Atlas.
- Atlas and Beacon cannot launch in back-to-back weeks.
